description: This file implements a React context provider for managing notes in a note-taking application. It includes state management, API interactions, toast notifications, and exposes methods for CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the Notes context within components.

methods.name: makeToast
methods.description: Creates a toast notification object with a unique ID, type, and message.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React component that provides notes state and CRUD methods to its children via context.
